comparison.objective: Fit and latch a phone into a hybrid case; candidate separates finishing media from workpieces.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid-part orientation, compliant-lip alignment, and sequential corner snapping versus load-shared screen manipulation and granular-flow control.
comparison.success_condition: Phone correctly oriented with all four corners seated, released and still versus recovery fraction, complete washer retention, loss/damage constraints, and screen dwell.
comparison.reason: Compliant enclosure assembly does not test bulk material separation.
